name: Butt Kicks
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Jog in place, kicking your heels up toward your glutes on each step.
Stay on the balls of your feet with a quick, light cadence.
Keep the torso upright and pump your arms. A classic dynamic warm-up drill.
longevityNotes: A stable trunk protects the spine through every decade. Train the core for endurance and control rather than chasing burn.
overview: Butt Kicks is a beginner core exercise targeting the hamstrings, performed with just your bodyweight. A strong trunk stabilizes every lift and protects the spine in daily life.
